notes.body: @whiskeyo could you take a look please?
Hello, I just reviewed the code and I do not have anything against merging it :smile:

added 3 commits
  • baf98935...585af996 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • c5743178 - eCPRI: Some updates for Message type 5
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18271/diffs?diff_id=1197766282&start_sha=baf989358006bd015856af1fda196988f5f110b4)

I updated after testing with a capture I made using scapy (which I plan to extend to cover those parts of ORAN FH CUS I don't have proper captures for yet).

The starting point for scapy was https://github.com/oran-testing/dos-attacker/blob/master/python_code/o_ran_fh.py   I added a (Packet) class for OneWayMeasurement, then generated a frame for each action type like this:

![image](/uploads/6602f59ec9a18f9023da13c229676d43/image.png){width=715 height=467}

One thing I did for message type 5 (but not yet everywhere) was to add the message-type-specific fields under ecpri_tree, rather than payload_tree, otherwise you might never find them, or at least have an unnecessary click each time.
